summary: Full Apple-Store-readiness audit of Ross House Rentals: 12 Railway backend endpoints (pytest, 15/20 passed, 5 documented failures) + Expo web mobile UI on localhost:3000 (5 tabs + Credit Builder + login flow). VERIFIED FIXES: (a) /api/rent-reporting/my-status (Credit Builder) now returns 200 — the recent jwt.decode + datetime serialization fix works on Railway; (b) Stripe refactor stripe_pkg/ is intact — /api/admin/rental-stripe-config, /api/admin/connect/status, /api/admin/stripe/webhook-events all 200 with admin JWT. CRITICAL FINDINGS: (1) Tenant in test_credentials.md (yoandyross2025@icloud.com / Test1234!) FAILS on Railway prod with 'Contraseña incorrecta' — credentials file is out of sync with production DB; had to fall back to maria@test.com / Test123! for tenant tests. (2) GET /api/tenant/payments and GET /api/tenant/contracts requested in the audit DO NOT EXIST in /app/ross-house-backend codebase — the real routes are /api/tenant/dashboard, /api/tenant/payment-history, /api/tenant/invoices/history. (3) GET /api/public/section8-welcome DOES NOT EXIST on Railway (404); only /api/tenant/section8/{status,declare} exist. (4) GET /api/tenant/section8/status returns 500 on Railway for maria@test.com — the `.isoformat()` call on `section8_declared_at` crashes when the stored value is a string instead of datetime (tenant_router.py:163). (5) Frontend bug: src/components/StripeWrapper.{tsx,web.tsx} and PayLayoutNative.native.tsx call `${EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL}/api/public/stripe-config`, but in /app/rosslending-app/.env that variable points to `https://banking-filter-hub.preview.emergentagent.com` (NOT Railway). Every screen logs a 404 from this wrong host. Should use EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL. — UI verdict: login (email/password) works, all 5 tabs (Inicio, Propiedades, Mercado, Pagos, Perfil) render with no red screens, Credit Builder opens & loads, no bundling errors, only deprecation warnings (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents) and the misrouted stripe-config 404.

critical.issue: Primary tenant credentials documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (yoandyross2025@icloud.com / Test1234!) return 401 'Contraseña incorrecta' on Railway prod. Admin (yoandyross@gmail.com / admin123) and legacy maria@test.com / Test123! work. Either reset the password on prod or update test_credentials.md.

Returns HTTP 500 on Railway prod for an authenticated tenant. Root cause (rental/tenant_router.py:163): `user.get('section8_declared_at').isoformat()` raises AttributeError when the stored value is a string (legacy/mongo). Guard with `isinstance(v, datetime)` or fall back to str(v).

404 Not Found on Railway. No such route exists in /app/ross-house-backend. The audit assumed this endpoint exists; the actual implemented paths are /api/tenant/dashboard (contract+payments) and /api/tenant/payment-history. Either add an alias or update the audit checklist.
404 Not Found on Railway. No such route exists. /api/tenant/dashboard returns the active contract; there is no list endpoint for tenant contracts.

404 Not Found on Railway. Route does not exist in the codebase (only /api/tenant/section8/declare and /api/tenant/section8/status exist). If a public landing endpoint is required, it must be implemented.

minor.issue: Returns 404 on Railway (verified via curl). Frontend Stripe wrappers call this on every screen, so even if the URL pointed to the right host the endpoint is missing. Either implement it or remove the call.

ui_bugs.issue: Hard-codes API_BASE=process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for `/api/public/stripe-config`. In /app/rosslending-app/.env this var resolves to https://banking-filter-hub.preview.emergentagent.com (Emergent preview host), NOT Railway. Every screen produces a 404. On Apple Store builds the variable may be unset → silent Stripe init failure → payment forms can break. Should be EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL (which points to Railway).
Console warning: 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' — React Native style prop not camelCased. Cosmetic in web; harmless on iOS but worth fixing.

Direct navigation to / after login redirects to /onboarding even when an authenticated session exists in storage. Tab-bar navigation works fine; the issue is only on hard reload at root. May confuse users who deep-link.

integration_issues.issue: Misrouted call to stripe-config (see UI bug above). 404 spam in production logs and a real risk of broken Stripe Elements on payment screens when EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is not the same host as the API.

issues: 'ROSS HOUSE RENTALS LLC' shown as legal footer — request asked us to verify no screen shows this as a 'crash text'. Confirmed: it is intentional branding, not a crash, but worth confirming with product.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings logged repeatedly: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow), 'textShadow*' style props (use textShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' (use style.pointerEvents). Reference: /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log and browser console.
[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect. — Web-only warning; harmless on iOS native build.

No data-testid / testID found anywhere on the rendered DOM (Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid]')).length === 0 on every screen tested). This blocks reliable Playwright/E2E automation. Add testID to login inputs, submit button, tab bar items, Credit Builder card, payment buttons.

action_items: P0: Reset the password for yoandyross2025@icloud.com on Railway prod DB to Test1234! OR update /app/memory/test_credentials.md with the real prod password. Currently blocks tenant marketplace QA.

P0: Fix tenant_router.py:163 — guard `section8_declared_at` isoformat. Patch: `declared_at = user.get('section8_declared_at'); declared_at.isoformat() if hasattr(declared_at, 'isoformat') else (declared_at or None)`.

P0: Decide intent for /api/tenant/payments and /api/tenant/contracts — either add aliases that proxy to /tenant/payment-history and /tenant/dashboard, or update the audit checklist & frontend consumers to use the real names.
P1: Implement /api/public/section8-welcome OR drop it from the audit. If marketing wants a public landing payload, add a small public router that returns voucher amounts / FAQ.

P1: In /app/rosslending-app/src/components/StripeWrapper.tsx, StripeWrapper.web.tsx and PayLayoutNative.native.tsx replace EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL (or read both with fallback). Then implement /api/public/stripe-config on Railway to return the publishable key/connect account id used by Stripe Elements.
P2: Replace deprecated style props (shadow*, textShadow*, props.pointerEvents) across the Expo app to silence warnings before TestFlight build #126.
P2: Fix transform-origin -> transformOrigin in the Pagos screen styles.
P2: Add `testID` to login form, tab bar, primary CTA buttons, and credit-builder/payment cards to make Playwright suites reliable.
critical_code_review_comments: rental/tenant_router.py:163 unsafe `.isoformat()` on a possibly-string DB field is a textbook 500 trigger; needs a type guard before TestFlight promotion.

Two .env keys (EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL vs EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) exist with DIFFERENT hosts. This dual-URL configuration is error-prone — code paths randomly pick one. Recommend collapsing to a single EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL and grep-replacing.

Stripe LIVE mode + a broken stripe-config call is a production risk: even with current 404 the Elements provider likely initialises with no publishable key on payment screens unless code falls back to EXPO_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY env. Verify the payment flow end-to-end before App Store submission.
test_credentials.md is treated as source of truth by every QA pass but is out of date for the primary tenant — should be CI-validated daily.
Backend rate limit on /api/public/marketplace-login is aggressive (60s after a handful of attempts). Good for security; document for QA so test runs don't cascade-skip.

success_rate.backend: 75% (15/20 pytest passed; 5 documented failures, 4 of which are missing/misnamed endpoints not real regressions)
success_rate.frontend: Login + 5 tabs + Credit Builder all load without red screens. Only known issues are the stripe-config 404 spam and deprecation warnings.

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. All tests use existing prod users (admin yoandyross@gmail.com, tenant maria@test.com). Section8 declare test sends is_section8=false — idempotent and does not alter the tenant's billing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_ross_house_railway.py — hits Railway prod directly. Backend rate limits at ~60s after a few login attempts (HTTP 429 'Demasiados intentos. Espera 60 segundos'); sleep between runs. The Expo app at localhost:3000 is /app/rosslending-app (supervisor program 'expo'), which targets Railway via EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL — login with maria@test.com / Test123! works; yoandyross2025@icloud.com / Test1234! is currently broken on prod. Frontend uses TWO env vars (EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL → Railway, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL → Emergent preview); confirm in PR which one the changed file uses.
rca_of_issue: [1] /api/tenant/section8/status 500 — In rental/tenant_router.py:147-164, the response builder calls `user.get('section8_declared_at').isoformat() if user.get('section8_declared_at') else None`. For tenants whose section8_declared_at was stored as ISO-string (legacy or via JSON serializer that already stringified the datetime), `.isoformat()` raises AttributeError → FastAPI returns 500. Reproduction: log in as maria@test.com, GET /api/tenant/section8/status → 500. Fix: replace with `_v = user.get('section8_declared_at'); declared_at = _v.isoformat() if hasattr(_v, 'isoformat') else _v`. [2] Stripe-config 404 — Frontend calls `${EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL}/api/public/stripe-config`. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://banking-filter-hub.preview.emergentagent.com (preview Emergent backend, not Ross House). That backend has no such route → 404 in every screen's network panel. Even if pointed to Railway the route does not exist in stripe_pkg/. Fix: (a) switch the env var in source to EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL; (b) add GET /api/public/stripe-config in stripe_pkg/ returning {publishable_key, connect_account_id}. [3] Tenant credentials drift — The Railway DB has a different bcrypt hash for yoandyross2025@icloud.com than what Test1234! produces. Either someone rotated the password in prod and forgot to update /app/memory/test_credentials.md, or the doc was wrong from the start. Fix: reset password to Test1234! via admin endpoint, or document the real password securely.
apple_store_verdict: NOT READY — but close. Two P0 backend issues (section8/status 500, tenant credentials drift) and one P1 frontend issue (stripe-config wrong host) must be resolved before App Store submission. Estimated fix time: ~2-3 hours (one-line backend patch + 3-file frontend env-var rename + password reset). After fixes, recommend a regression pass against this same test_ross_house_railway.py plus a manual flow on TestFlight build #126: launch app → skip onboarding → login → tap each tab → tap Credit Builder → tap Pagar Renta → verify Stripe sheet opens with the correct publishable key. Apart from those blockers, the core paths (login, tab navigation, Credit Builder, admin stripe-pkg refactor, admin CRUD for rental-payments/properties/tenants) are working on the LIVE Railway stack.
